<!-- All news items below this line -->
'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Prisoners of war in the Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***[[Russia]] and [[Ukraine]] exchange hundreds of [[prisoners of war]] in a deal brokered by the [[United Arab Emirates]]. Ukraine says that many of those released by Russia are soldiers captured during the [[Siege of Mariupol]] in 2022. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c938x3v148yo (BBC News)]
*[[Sudanese civil war (2023-present)|Sudanese civil war]]
**[[Battle of Khartoum (2023-present)|Battle of Khartoum]]
***The [[Government of Sudan|Sudanese government]] says at least nine people are killed and 121 others injured in shelling by the [[Rapid Support Forces]] in [[Khartoum]]. [https://sudantribune.com/article295274/ (Sudan Tribune)]
*[[Israeli invasion of Syria (2024–present)|Israeli invasion of Syria]]
**[[Israel Defense Forces]] operating in the [[Agreement on Disengagement between Israel and Syria|Syrian side of the 1974 buffer zone]], in [[Quneitra Governorate]], advance into the Syrian town of [[Madinat al-Baath]]. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/liveblog_entry/reports-idf-troops-advance-in-syria-buffer-zone-search-government-buildings-in-madinat-al-baath/ (''The Times of Israel'')]
*[[Trinidad and Tobago]] declares a [[state of emergency]] as [[crime in Trinidad and Tobago|gang violence]] escalates in the country, after five people were shot dead at a shop in [[Laventille]], [[Port of Spain]], the previous day. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cvgnzg40p7eo (BBC News)] [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/12/30/trinidad-and-tobago-announces-state-of-emergency-to-combat-gang-violence (Al Jazeera)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Syrian civil war]]
**[[Fall of the Assad regime]]
***The [[First Syrian transitional government|Syrian transitional government]] appoints [[Maysaa Sabreen]] as the first female governor of the [[Central Bank of Syria]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/syrias-new-rulers-appoint-maysaa-sabrine-lead-central-bank-official-says-2024-12-30/ (Reuters)]
*[[Moldova–Russia relations]]
**[[Prime Minister of Moldova|Moldovan prime minister]] [[Dorin Recean]] states his country is envisaging the possible nationalization of the [[Moldovagaz]] energy company, which Russia's [[Gazprom]] owns 50% of, following the announcement by Gazprom that the current gas supply deal that expires on December 31 will not be renewed. [https://www.reuters.com/business/energy/moldova-prepares-possible-moldovagaz-nationalisation-2024-12-30/ (Reuters)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*In [[Pakistan]], ten people are killed and seven are injured in a bus crash on a highway in [[Fateh Jang]], [[Punjab, Pakistan|Punjab]]. Separately, eight people are killed during a van–truck collision in [[Naushahro Feroze]], [[Sindh]]. [https://apnews.com/article/pakistan-speeding-bus-highway-accidents-83e8bcef3bc9ce2ca8531487a991ef0c (AP)]
*Three tourists are killed and seven others are injured in a fire at a hotel on [[Khaosan Road]] in [[Bangkok]], [[Thailand]]. [https://apnews.com/article/thailand-ember-hotel-fire-tourism-khao-san-road-0d335679d5c8bc1ebf1161c6b6d36683 (AP)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Syria–Ukraine relations]]
**[[Syria]] says that it hopes to form a "strategic partnership" with [[Ukraine]] following a high-level meeting in [[Damascus]], Syria, between Syria's de-facto leader [[Ahmed al-Sharaa]] and [[Minister of Foreign Affairs (Ukraine)|Ukrainian foreign minister]] [[Andrii Sybiha]], where the two countries re-established diplomatic relations. Ukraine also vowed to send additional food aid to Syria. [https://www.reuters.com/world/syrias-de-facto-leader-hosts-ukraines-foreign-minister-sana-says-2024-12-30/ (Reuters)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2024 South Korean martial law crisis]]
**The [[Corruption Investigation Office for High-ranking Officials]] formally requests an [[arrest warrant]] for [[Impeachment of Yoon Suk Yeol|impeached]] [[President of South Korea|South Korean president]] [[Yoon Suk Yeol]] over his declaration of [[martial law]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/skorea-joint-investigation-unit-requests-arrest-warrant-yoon-over-martial-law-2024-12-30/ (Reuters)]
*[[2024 Venezuelan protests]]
**[[Public Ministry of Venezuela|Venezuelan prosecutor general]] [[Tarek William Saab]] announces the release of 413 protesters from prison. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/venezuela-free-additional-413-election-protesters-2024-12-30/ (Reuters)]
*[[Donald Trump sexual misconduct allegations]]
**The [[U.S. Second Circuit Court of Appeals]] upholds a jury verdict finding [[Donald Trump]] liable for sexual abuse and defamation in ''[[E. Jean Carroll v. Donald J. Trump]]''. [https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/politics/2024/12/30/trump-e-jean-carroll-sexual-abuse-defamation-appeal/75680589007/ (''USA Today'')]
*[[Yazidi genocide]]
**[[Germany]]'s [[Public Prosecutor General (Germany)|federal prosecutor]] charges an [[Iraqis|Iraqi]] couple, allegedly members of the [[Islamic State]], with enslavement, [[torture]], and war crimes, after they allegedly kept two [[Yazidis|Yazidi]] girls as slaves and sexually and physically abused them. [https://www.dw.com/en/germany-iraqi-couple-accused-of-abusing-yazidi-girls/a-71186224 (DW)]
*An [[Argentina|Argentine]] judge issues [[arrest warrant]]s for [[President of Nicaragua|Nicaraguan president]] [[Daniel Ortega]], [[Vice President of Nicaragua|Vice President]] [[Rosario Murillo]], and several others for alleged [[crimes against humanity]], invoking [[universal jurisdiction]]. [https://www.arabnews.com/node/2584792/world (''Arab News'')]
*[[Cuba]] releases [[Salvadorans|Salvadoran]] national Raúl Ernesto Cruz León after he completed a 30-year prison sentence for his involvement in the [[1997 Cuba hotel bombings|1997 hotel bombings]]. [https://www.bssnews.net/international/234693 (BSS)]
*The [[Supreme Tribunal of Justice (Venezuela)|Supreme Court]] of [[Venezuela]] fines social media platform [[TikTok]] $10 million for "not implementing measures" to prevent viral [[internet challenge|challenges]] that allegedly led to the death of three children. [https://apnews.com/article/venezuela-tiktok-viral-video-childrens-deaths-c2e9a4d6f7387c72d0c53b881c54786d (AP)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[Death and state funeral of Jimmy Carter]]
**[[President of the United States|U.S. president]] [[Joe Biden]] orders a [[state funeral]] for former president [[Jimmy Carter]] to be held in [[Washington, D.C.]] on January 9. Biden also orders flags to be lowered to [[half-mast|half-staff]] for thirty days in accordance with federal law. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/live/ce98937nrqrt (BBC News)]
*[[Treatment of women by the Taliban]]
**The [[Taliban government]] of [[Afghanistan]] announces it will close all national and foreign [[nongovernmental organizations]] in the country that currently employ [[Women in Afghanistan|women]]. [https://apnews.com/article/afghanistan-taliban-ngo-women-closure-1fde989369785f8df0e83c81d48626f1 (AP)]
*[[Kenya Police]] fire [[tear gas]] at demonstrators in [[Nairobi]] protesting against alleged [[Government of Kenya|government]] [[extrajudicial punishment|extrajudicial]] [[kidnapping|abduction]]s in the past few months. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/12/30/kenya-police-fire-tear-gas-at-protest-against-alleged-government-abductions (Al Jazeera)]
*[[President of the Philippines|Philippine president]] [[Bongbong Marcos]] signs an [[Ordinance Power of the President of the Philippines|order]] removing [[Vice President of the Philippines|Vice President]] [[Sara Duterte]] and [[List of presidents of the Philippines|former presidents]] from the [[National Security Council (Philippines)|National Security Council]], allowing the president to appoint other officials and private citizens as members. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/philippines-marcos-drops-estranged-vp-duterte-security-council-2025-01-03/ (Reuters)]

'''Science and technology'''
*The [[ISRO|Indian Space Research Organisation]] successfully launches its [[Polar Satellite Launch Vehicle]] rocket carrying the [[SPADEX|Space Docking Experiment]] twin satellite mission from the [[Satish Dhawan Space Centre]] in [[Andhra Pradesh]], with the satellites expected to perform a [[docking and berthing of spacecraft|docking]] maneuver on January 7, 2025. [https://www.dw.com/en/india-successfully-launches-its-first-space-docking-mission/a-71187928 (DW)] [https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/india/isro-launches-space-docking-satellites-india-on-path-to-elite-club-pslv-last-stage-has-24-payloads/articleshow/116805228.cms (''The Times of India'')]
